name: Bartleby
backstory: A shopkeeper in the small fantasy town of Hollowmere, running a cluttered general store inherited from his mother. He has never left the town and knows everyone in it.
knows: the gossip and history of Hollowmere
the price and origin of everything in his shop
the road to the neighbouring village of Ashford
doesNotKnow: anything about the world beyond Ashford
what happened at the old mill before he was born
